newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Entertainment to refinance.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Entertainment to refinance.

text.p: Trans World Entertainment Corp said Friday a tentative debt refinancing agreement has been reached with Congress Financial Corp, a CoreStates Financial Corp company.
The agreement provides interest rates averaging below the prime rate, Trans World said.
Specific terms of the preliminary refinancing agreement will be announced after the final loan documents are complete, the company said, adding this is anticipated in the next 30 days.

Chief Executive Officer Robert J. Higgins commented, "This new debt agreement finalizes our successful restructuring efforts. By offering such favorable rates, our lenders clearly recognize that we have effectively repositioned our company.
"Based on current borrowing levels, the company will save up to $2.5 million per year in interest charges alone," he said.
Trans World said it currently has fixed debt of $45 million and unused lines of credit totaling $52 million, with interest rates of 11.5 percent and 11 percent, respectively.

Trans World Entertainment operates 478 retail stores in malls, freestanding and strip center locations under several names, including Record Town, Coconuts Music and Movies, Saturday Matinee and F.Y.E.
